verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships several AI-generated suggestion features on documentation content — the AI Linter checks pages against natural-language rules, Docs Audit surfaces outdated/inconsistent content, and the GitHub AI Writer proposes doc updates when code changes — which count as AI-generated insights/suggestions derived from the product's own data (docs and PRs). However, this is scoped to content quality/consistency rather than broader data (e.g., API usage/analytics) getting AI-generated insights; API Metrics/analytics are presented as raw charts/reports without AI-generated commentary. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated insights on analytics/usage data (not just doc content), and independent/hands-on validation of suggestion quality.
